questions.question: If the distance between two objects is doubled, the gravitational force between them will

options.explanation: Gravitational force decreases with increasing distance
Gravitational force decreases with increasing distance
Correct relationship between gravitational force and distance
Gravitational force decreases with increasing distance

questions.explanation: According to Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation, the gravitational force (F) between two objects is inversely proportional to the square of the distance (r) between their centers (F ∝ 1/r²). If the distance (r) is doubled (2r), the force becomes F' ∝ 1/(2r)² = 1/(4r²). Thus, the new force F' will be one-fourth of the original force F.

questions.question: A boy of mass 40 kg climbs up a flight of 50 stairs, each 15 cm high, in 10 seconds. What is the power exerted by the boy

Incorrect calculation of power

questions.explanation: Mass of the boy (m) = 40 kg. Total height climbed (h) = Number of stairs × Height of each stair = 50 × 15 cm = 750 cm = 7.5 m. Time taken (t) = 10 s. Acceleration due to gravity (g) = 10 m/s². Work done (W) = Force × Displacement = Weight × Height = m × g × h = 40 kg × 10 m/s² × 7.5 m = 3000 J. questions.question: Assertion (A): The acceleration due to gravity (g) is maximum at the poles and minimum at the equator. Reason (R): The Earth is not a perfect sphere; it is flattened at the poles and bulges at the equator, meaning the radius is smaller at the poles

questions.explanation: The acceleration due to gravity (g) is inversely proportional to the square of the distance from the center of the Earth (g = GM/R²). questions.explanation: The acceleration due to gravity (g) varies with location on Earth.
